listing.name: Project Gotham Racing 2 — pgr2-recomp (hk21x)
listing.summary: Upstream reports boot, movies, menus, races in every mode tried, saves and System Link. This is not a demonstrated complete career/campaign. Sound-effect reverb/filters remain unmodeled; experimental 60FPS races can dip in busy streets. The current README adds top-right Quit game and Alt+F4 exit controls. No Portcove setup, package, controller, networking or gameplay qualification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Title4D53004B PALv2 XBE SHA1 676895b86f01938804c5f1cdcad8b44044295cb4 or NTSCv5 ec6e902fc167de349f1dc1838a7441dfff932c62; media-patched profiles separately listed

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README advertises PGR2Launcher.exe via latest release. On Windows10/11 x86-64, select an owned supported PAL/NTSC ISO or disc folder; the launcher downloads portable Clang/CMake/Ninja/Git/Microsoft build tools plus project source and compiles the game locally (upstream estimates30–90minutes, about15GB space and1.4GB tools). It does not download original game code. Later Play/Update reuse or rebuild local output; owned game data remains required. Source route uses recursive submodules, assets/default.xbe plus disc data, VisualStudio2022 C++/Clang/CMake and build.bat. No launcher artifact was downloaded or its digest inspected.
